titulo: Black Sea sailors thought a rescue boat was racing toward them. Instead, it was a drone that sank their ship
cuerpo: The Dignity is one of nearly 50 commercial vessels that maritime analysts say have been attacked in the Black Sea in October alone. The strikes are part of an escalating conflict that has brought much of the traffic through the key shipping corridor to a halt and prompted NATO to step up maritime security, including by deploying more patrol boats and radar.
